description: Read-only ranked complementary activities anchored to a source product_id. Each recommendation includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, and a standardized `item_card`.

date.description: Date to plan for (YYYY-MM-DD). When given, availability on that date is checked for each candidate and used in ranking.
date.title: Date

has_children.description: Whether the group includes children. When true, adult-only activities are left out.
has_children.title: Has Children

includes_children.description: Alias for has_children, kept for older clients. Prefer has_children.
includes_children.title: Includes Children

location.description: The guest's location: a place name or address (e.g. "Key West, FL"), a "lat,lng" string, or an object with `lat` and `lng`.
location.title: Location

party_size.description: Number of guests. Activities whose maximum group size is smaller are left out.
party_size.title: Party Size

product_id.description: ID of the activity the guest has booked or is considering, as returned by search_activities. Recommendations are nearby activities that pair well with it.
product_id.title: Product Id

radius_miles.description: Preferred distance from the anchor activity, in miles. If too few activities are that close, a radius under 30 miles widens to 30.
radius_miles.title: Radius Miles

time_slot.description: Start time of the anchor activity.
time_slot.title: Time Slot

name: get_complementary_recommendation
